title: Irish Potato Grilled Schnitzel
description: A German-inspired take on the classic schnitzel, using Irish potatoes and grilled to perfection.
instructions: Peel the Irish potatoes and slice them into 1/4 inch thick rounds.
Season the fish with salt and pepper.
Dip each piece of fish into the beaten eggs and then coat with the sliced Irish potatoes.
Place the coated fish onto the preheated grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve immediately with a side of yellowed butter and lemon wedges.
Note: If using a grill pan, cook for 3-4 minutes per side.
